q: A ____ is an electronic device which takes an information from the environment, makes a decision based on that information and then gives out the result.
e: A logic gate is an electronic device which takes an information from the environment, makes a decision based on that information and then gives out the result. Logic gate is what this statement is using.

q: Logic gates can be built up using ____ of resistors, diodes and transistors.
e: A p-n junction conducts easily one way and blocks the other. That is a diode. Logic gates can be built up using discrete components of resistors, diodes and transistors.

q: However, it is more convenient to use small ____.
e: However, it is more convenient to use small integrated circuits (ICs). Integrated circuits (ics) is what this statement is using.

q: The five common logic gates are ____ gates.
c: AND, OR, NAND, NOR and NOT (inverter)
e: The five common logic gates are AND, OR, NAND, NOR and NOT (inverter) gates. And, or, nand, nor and not (inverter) is what this statement is using.

q: Logic gate can have two or more inputs but only ____.
e: Logic gate can have two or more inputs but only one output. One output is what this statement is using.
But, NOT gate has only one input. One input is what this statement is using.

q: For a 2-input AND gate, output X is HIGH only when inputs A and B are ____.
e: For a 2-input AND gate, output X is HIGH only when inputs A and B are HIGH. High is what this statement is using.

q: The Boolean expression for a 2-input AND gate is ____.
e: The Boolean expression for a 2-input AND gate is X=AB. Leave the relation as X=AB.

q: For a 2-input OR gate, output X is LOW only when both A and B are ____.
e: For a 2-input OR gate, output X is LOW only when both A and B are LOW. Low is what this statement is using.

q: The Boolean expression for a 2-input OR gate is ____.
e: The Boolean expression for a 2-input OR gate is X=A+B. Leave the relation as X=A+B. X=a+b is what this sentence is naming. Stay with the quantity named in this sentence.

q: For a 2-input NAND gate, output X is LOW only when inputs A and B are ____.
e: For a 2-input NAND gate, output X is LOW only when inputs A and B are HIGH. High is what this statement is using.

q: The Boolean expression for a 2-input NAND gate is ____.
e: The Boolean expression for a 2-input NAND gate is X=AB. Leave the relation as X=AB.

q: For a 2-input NOR gate, output X is HIGH only when both A and B are ____.
e: For a 2-input NOR gate, output X is HIGH only when both A and B are LOW. Low is what this statement is using.

q: The Boolean expression for a 2-input NOR gate is ____.
e: The Boolean expression for a 2-input NOR gate is X=A+B. Leave the relation as X=A+B. X=a+b is what this sentence is naming. Stay with the quantity named in this sentence.

q: The NAND gate and NOR gate are popular logic gates because they can be used as ____, that is, they alone can be used in combination to perform the functions of any other types of gates.
e: The NAND gate and NOR gate are popular logic gates because they can be used as universal gates, that is, they alone can be used in combination to perform the functions of any other types of gates. Universal gates is what this statement is using.

q: The inverter (NOT gate) performs the operation called ____.
e: The inverter (NOT gate) performs the operation called inversion. The name used here is inversion.

q: The inverter changes one logic level to the ____.
e: The inverter changes one logic level to the opposite level. Opposite level is what this statement is using.

q: When a LOW level is applied to its input, a ____ will appear on its output.
e: When a LOW level is applied to its input, a HIGH level will appear on its output. High level is what this statement is using.

q: The Boolean expression for a NOT gate is ____.
e: The Boolean expression for a NOT gate is X=A. Leave the relation as X=A. X=a is what this sentence is naming. Stay with the quantity named in this sentence.
